hideLabel.description: Keeps the label for screen readers only.

value.description: Controlled number in E.164, such as "+14155550132". An empty string clears the field.

onValueChange.description: Fires on every edit with the E.164 number (empty without digits) and { country, formatted, status, valid }.

country.description: Controlled ISO code of the selected country.

defaultCountry.description: ISO code used until someone picks a country or enters an international number.

onCountryChange.description: Called when the country changes, including from a pasted number.

countries.description: Limit the picker to these ISO codes.

preferredCountries.description: Pinned at the top of the picker under Suggested.

validate.description: Show a message after blur when the number has the wrong length.

disabled.description: Disables the number and the picker.

name.description: Adds a hidden input carrying the E.164 value for native form submission.

onBlur.description: Called when the number input loses focus.
